name: warm-kitchen
description: A complete, deployable, installable Progressive Web App for browsing recipes from [TheMealDB](https://www.themealdb.com/), saving your favorites into a server-owned collection, and following each recipe **hands-free** in a distraction-free cooking mode that holds the screen awake.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,client -c terracotta,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
